items.title: Sheila Jordan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Actually, the songs of the day were quite hip. They were a lot of Cole Porter and, you know, and they would have this music.

ctx.x: Well, my… I have Native American so, on my grandfather‟s side. Also on my father‟s side. But getting back to me being born, my father never raised me. He sort of married my mother to give me a name and then that was it. He never sent money to support me or I didn‟t visit him until I was in Detroit, „til I was a teenager. And uh, and even then, he was kinda standoffish, you know. But um… that‟s what happened to me. So when I moved to Detroit, I was… it was great. I was thrilled to be in Detroit „cause I loved to…
If we could return to your early years, first if you could tell us your parents‟ names?
